user.title: Audi Connect
user.description: Set your account options. On the next screen you will sign in with your Audi account in a browser.

data_description.spin: Optional S-PIN, required for vehicle actions such as lock/unlock and engine start.
data_description.api_level: For Audi vehicles, the API request data structure varies by model. Newer vehicles use an updated data structure compared to older models. This can be changed later via the Reconfigure option.

device.title: Sign in to Audi
device.description:
Open the following link and sign in with your Audi account to authorise Home Assistant:

[{verification_uri}]({verification_uri})

If you are asked for a code, enter: **{user_code}**

Once you have approved it, press **OK**.

auth0.title: Sign in to Audi
auth0.description: Open [{authorization_url}]({authorization_url}) in a private browser window and sign in. Audi then redirects to a localhost page that may show an unable-to-connect error; this is expected. Copy the complete URL from the browser address bar and paste it below.

reauth_auth0.title: Re-authenticate with Audi
reauth_auth0.description: Open [{authorization_url}]({authorization_url}) in a private browser window and sign in. Audi then redirects to a localhost page that may show an unable-to-connect error; this is expected. Copy the complete URL from the browser address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Audi
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Audi authorisation has expired. Open the following link and sign in again:

{verification_uri}

If you are asked for a code, enter: **{user_code}**

Once you have approved it, press **OK**.

data_description.spin: Optional S-PIN for vehicle actions such as lock/unlock.
data_description.region: The region associated with your Audi Connect account.
data_description.api_level: For Audi vehicles, the API request data structure varies by model. Newer vehicles use an updated data structure compared to older models.

credentials.title: Sign in to Audi
credentials.description: Enter your myAudi username and password.

reauth_credentials.title: Re-authenticate with Audi
reauth_credentials.description: Your Audi sign-in is no longer working. Enter your credentials again.

data.edit_local_dealer: Edit dealer and local service details

data_description.scan_initial: Perform a cloud update immediately upon startup.
data_description.refresh_vehicle_data_after_action: Send a vehicle refresh command after every service action (e.g. climate, lock). This is typically not required as the vehicle will check in with the cloud on its own after a command. Each vehicle refresh counts against the API rate limit. To improve responsiveness, increase the Cloud Refresh Delay instead.
data_description.update_sleep: Seconds to wait after a service action before refreshing cloud data. A longer delay gives the vehicle more time to report its updated state to the cloud.
data_description.filter_vins: Comma-separated VIN list to exclude from setup and updates.
data_description.edit_local_dealer: Open the form to save dealership, service appointment and warranty details locally, without any Audi API requests.
data_description.runtime_version: V2 retains historical stable functionality. V3 — Experimental uses independent capability discovery, polling, API configuration and Home Assistant entities. Switch back here at any time.
data_description.v3_development_workbench: Show the administrator-only API Development Workbench in the Home Assistant sidebar. Available in V3 only. Off by default; disabling does not delete saved API profiles.
data_description.run_vehicle_discovery: Review automatic read discovery and explicitly test eligible physical actions without the Engineering Workbench. No vehicle action runs unless you consent to that specific action.
data_description.v3_data_act_enabled: Read only from an existing authorized Data Act request. Off by default. Vehicle measurements can be days old.
data_description.v3_data_act_email: Leave empty to reuse the existing myAudi email, if stored. No new account or consent is created.
data_description.v3_data_act_password: Leave empty to keep the stored portal password or reuse the existing myAudi password, if stored. Disabling removes separate portal credentials.

dealer.title: Dealer and service (local)
dealer.description: The details remain in Home Assistant. This feature does not retrieve dealer information from Audi.

discovery.title: Vehicle discovery
discovery.description: {vehicle}: {read_state}. Read assessment {read}% ({assessed}/{total}); physically verified controls {verified}/{controls} catalog candidates. Read assessment is not proof of vehicle support. Refresh is read-only. No remaining eligible tests in this session. Finish or refresh read discovery.

discovery_consent.title: Discover vehicle function?
discovery_consent.description: {vehicle} — {action}. Verified {verified}/{controls}; skipped {skipped}. This authorizes this specific physical action on the vehicle and may unlock or lock doors, change charging or climate operation, or flash lights. Ensure the vehicle is safely parked, you are authorized and present, nobody is endangered, and you can inspect and restore its state. Only a definitively rejected command may use one reviewed equivalent route. No automatic repeat after uncertainty and no other action.

discovery_review.title: Did it work?
discovery_review.description: {vehicle}: {action}. Transport result: {transport}. Check the actual vehicle, not just its cloud response. OK saves the working route. Not OK records failure. Not sure leaves the action pending; no additional physical test is sent.

discovery_recover.title: Resolve pending command
discovery_recover.description: {vehicle}: previous {action} outcome is uncertain. Inspect the actual vehicle before acknowledging. This sends no new command and does not certify success.

data.inspected: I inspected the vehicle and acknowledge the prior command outcome

error.invalid_dealer: Check date, website and field lengths.
error.discovery_test_failed: The action could not be completed. Check the current vehicle state and try again only after the pending outcome has been resolved.

abort.no_vehicle_available: No Audi vehicle is currently loaded.

refresh_vehicle_data.name: Refresh Vehicle Data
refresh_vehicle_data.description: Requests an update of the vehicle state directly, as opposed to the normal update mechanism which only retrieves data from the cloud.

execute_vehicle_action.name: Execute Vehicle Action
execute_vehicle_action.description: Performs various actions on the vehicle.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to perform the action on.

action.name: Action
action.description: The specific action to perform on the vehicle. Note that available actions may vary based on the vehicle.

start_climate_control.name: Start Climate Control
start_climate_control.description: Start the climate control with options for temperature, glass surface heating, and auto seat comfort.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to start climate control on.

temp_f.name: Target Temperature (Fahrenheit)
temp_f.description: (Optional) Set temperature in °F. Defaults to 70°F if not provided. Overrides 'temp_c'.

temp_c.name: Target Temperature (Celsius)
temp_c.description: (Optional) Set temperature in °C. Defaults to 21°C if not provided. Overridden if 'temp_f' is provided.

glass_heating.name: Glass Surface Heating
glass_heating.description: (Optional) Enable or disable glass surface heating.

seat_fl.name: Auto Seat Comfort: Front-Left
seat_fl.description: (Optional) Enable or disable Auto Seat Comfort for the front-left seat.

seat_fr.name: Auto Seat Comfort: Front-Right
seat_fr.description: (Optional) Enable or disable Auto Seat Comfort for the front-right seat.

seat_rl.name: Auto Seat Comfort: Rear-Left
seat_rl.description: (Optional) Enable or disable Auto Seat Comfort for the rear-left seat.

seat_rr.name: Auto Seat Comfort: Rear-Right
seat_rr.description: (Optional) Enable or disable Auto Seat Comfort for the rear-right seat.

climatisation_at_unlock.name: Climatisation at Unlock
climatisation_at_unlock.description: (Optional) Enable climate control to continue when vehicle is unlocked.

climatisation_mode.name: Climatisation Mode
climatisation_mode.description: (Optional) Maximum comfort (Comfort) or energy-saving (Economy). Default is Comfort.

refresh_cloud_data.name: Refresh Cloud Data
refresh_cloud_data.description: Retrieves current cloud data without triggering a vehicle refresh. Data may be outdated if the vehicle has not checked in recently.

start_auxiliary_heating.name: Start Auxiliary Heating
start_auxiliary_heating.description: Start auxiliary heating the vehicle, with option for duration.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to start auxiliary heating on.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The number of minutes the auxiliary heater should run before turning off. Default is 20 minutes if not provided.

set_location_charge_target.name: Set Location Charge Target
set_location_charge_target.description: Set a location charging profile's target state of charge. This is the value that actually governs where a charge stops at that location, unlike the global target. It is a persistent setting: it applies to every charge at that location until changed.

profile_id.name: Profile
profile_id.description: The charging profile id to change. Leave empty to change whichever profile the car is currently parked in.

target_soc.name: Target State of Charge
target_soc.description: Target charge level for this location, 20-100% in steps of 5.

set_charge_mode.name: Set Charge Mode
set_charge_mode.description: Set which mode the vehicle charges in. This is a preference and does not start or stop a charge in progress.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to set the charge mode for.

charge_mode.name: Charge Mode
charge_mode.description: manual charges whenever plugged in; timer charges only during the vehicle's scheduled times.

set_target_soc.name: Set Target State of Charge
set_target_soc.description: Set the target state of charge (battery %) for the vehicle.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to set the target charge level for.

start_engine.name: Start Engine
start_engine.description: Remotely start the vehicle engine. Requires the S-PIN to be set in the configuration.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to start the engine on.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Audi vehicle to stop the engine on.
